  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:6058035761",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Implement a broader cache shared with IPC createnewblock, waitnext, and the mempool fee estimator as attempted in #33421",
      "quote": "I think we can implement the broader cache as attempted here #33421, mempool estimator dependency on `ChainStateManager` will be gone, and the ipc `createnewblock`, `waitnext` and `getblocktemplate` R",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "accepted deferring to follow-ups",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6065621630"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6074366875",
      "status_by_quote": "However, I agree this is a start; we can extend it later."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4226656184",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Should the cache be cleared on a block connection instead of keeping it until shutdown?",
      "quote": "The cache is kept forever till shutdown. Should we clear it on a block connection?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained master already keeps it until shutdown and clearing on connect requires a notification hook better left for a follow-up",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4406943630"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4406943630",
      "status_by_quote": "Clearing it on block connection would need a new notification hook in the manager, so I'd leave that for a follow-up."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4226664736",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Pass max_age as a parameter so that the caching logic is not tied to getblocktemplate",
      "quote": "Should we pass the `max_age` so that it is not tied to GBT?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained max_age fits better in a follow-up that makes the cache generic, and named the constant GBT_TEMPLATE_REBUILD_INTERVAL",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4406966061"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4406966061",
      "status_by_quote": "I'd keep `max_age` out of this PR. The cache is still a single entry built with the default options, so another caller with a different `max_age` would just keep rebuilding the GBT template."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:6058035761",
